title: PAR-07/S8.3 raw-object journal ownership transfer
scope: Transfer the journal-owned DRW_UnsupportedObject to move-aware consumers without breaking const-reference-only consumers
Make raw-object journal delivery one-shot after ownership is moved
Verify allocation identity and callback count with generated in-memory controls

changes.detail: Added trailing non-pure addUnsupportedObject(DRW_UnsupportedObject&&); default forwards to the existing const-reference callback. Source compatibility is retained; binary ABI compatibility is not claimed.

MoveValueEvent now uses the rvalue callback, tracks delivery, and refuses a second replay. Added a typed internal appendValue overload to preserve existing const-reference callback member-pointer call sites despite the overload.
Declared the typed const-reference callback overload used to disambiguate existing raw-object appendValue call sites.

Extended the existing generated modeler/raw-object selector to verify one-shot replay, default forwarding to a legacy const-reference receiver, and same-vector-allocation transfer to a move-aware receiver using 256 KiB payloads.

limitations: The change does not reduce copies for const-reference-only receivers, change dx_iface raw-entity retention policy, remove the AcDs section-to-entity payload attachment copy, or qualify DWG/DXF/ACIS semantics. No full suite, external peer, native CAD application, or geometry kernel was run.
workingTree: The checkout contains extensive pre-existing modified and untracked work. This slice was not staged or committed; unrelated changes were left untouched.
